github.title: Duplicate shipment replay
github.body:
Reported by Maya Chen (Acme Logistics)

Blocker: duplicate shipment events on retries. Deduplicate with shipment_id and event_version. Rollback if duplicate-rate exceeds 0.2% for 15 minutes.
comments: **Maya Chen (Acme Logistics):** Confirmed this is the current engagement requirement.
